answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent buys one slot by burning a $20 deposit, which creates a public signal that the slot is live. The deposit rests on a ledge above the burn pit: the agent must send a pulse heartbeat every day, and missing two pulses tips the deposit off the ledge to burn. Forging 1,000 slots costs $20,000 in burned deposits plus 1,000 daily heartbeats, while an honest agent pays $20 once and keeps undiluted slot rewards.
